question:
Which of the following salts will give an aqueous solution having pH of almost 7?

(i) NH₄Cl

(ii) Na₂CO₃

(iii) K₂SO₄
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only (iii).**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** salt **which will give an **aqueous solution** having pH of almost **7** is** K2SO4.**
 
• K2SO4 is a **neutral salt** as it is formed by the combination of a **strong base (KOH**) and a** strong acid (H₂SO₄).**
